svg.title: Only warning tariffs receive the factor h. The packet tariffis zero unless the packet is connected in the specified enlarged geometry. Otherwise it is its displayed block-packet income. Forced tariffs are the old forced envelopes, regular tariffs bound both the local log and exp(log)-1, and warning pointwise tariffs are the fixed storm bound. The source proves these four pointwise inequalities on the same local data and sector. Write Fp = Q i∈p fi. The triangle inequality for a finite product gives | bodyp(Y, z)| ≤Fp for every tree-gauge variable Y and Gaussian fluctuation z. If bodyp(Y, z) is nonzero, every warning detector in B(p) is nonzero. The warning estimate then places z in the joint catastrophe event CB(p), whose Gaussian probability is at most hˆ|B(p)|.
